Tab: Agent Summary / Team Rollup / Monthly / Rankings
Finding: All historical periods are live formulas recalculated on every workbook edit
Business impact if unaddressed: ~40s of the 45s recalculation is spent recomputing settled history; users avoid touching the workbook
Recommendation: Split OPEN vs CLOSED periods; write closed periods once as values with an explicit logged reopen path

Finding: VLOOKUP by column index against full-column ranges A:Z
Business impact if unaddressed: Returns a different field with no error if a column is inserted upstream; already occurred once and took 2 days to trace
Recommendation: Replace with XLOOKUP / INDEX+MATCH resolving the column by header name over bounded ranges

Finding: Blanket IFERROR(...,"") suppresses every error to blank
Business impact if unaddressed: No way to distinguish a broken lookup from a legitimate zero; wrong figures publish silently
Recommendation: Typed markers (#NO_AGENT / #NO_RATE) plus automated checks that block the weekly close

Location: 3 QUERY strings, 4 COUNTIFS, 2 validation lists, Rankings, 4 script constants
Finding: Agent and team roster hardcoded across the system
Business impact if unaddressed: Onboarding one agent needs 14 coordinated edits; missing one silently excludes their revenue from rollups
Recommendation: Config/Agents/Teams tabs as single source of truth; effective-date agent records

Finding: Three-level IMPORTRANGE chain across 4 source workbooks
Business impact if unaddressed: Compounded refresh latency; an upstream failure arrives downstream as a blank cell indistinguishable from no sales
Recommendation: One landing tab per source; downstream tabs read internally; add a staleness check

Finding: Company tab uses RANK (competition) and team tab uses COUNTIFS (dense)
Business impact if unaddressed: Tied agents receive different ranks depending on which tab is opened; already surfaced in a commission dispute
Recommendation: One documented tie rule applied everywhere; compute in script

Finding: NOW() in header cells forces a full recalculation cascade on every edit
Business impact if unaddressed: Every keystroke anywhere in the workbook triggers a full recalc
Recommendation: Script-written static timestamp on the Config tab; reference it

Finding: 4100 rows of formulas below the last row of source data
Business impact if unaddressed: Pure recalculation waste on every edit
Recommendation: Trim the trailing rows or convert the columns to self-extending ARRAYFORMULA

Finding: Ranking ranges hardcoded to row 500
Business impact if unaddressed: Agents beyond row 500 are unranked with no error shown
Recommendation: Script-side ranking with no row limit

Finding: 612-character formula with 11 nested IFs
Business impact if unaddressed: Nobody can review it correctly so errors survive indefinitely
Recommendation: Decompose into named helper columns or move to script

Finding: Commission tiers encoded as an 8-level nested IF
Business impact if unaddressed: A business rule Finance owns is hidden in a formula only one person can read
Recommendation: Move tiers to a CommissionTiers lookup table sorted descending by threshold

Finding: 5 triggers: 2 duplicates, 1 pointing at a function renamed in 2024
Business impact if unaddressed: One job runs twice; another has failed nightly for 8 months unnoticed
Recommendation: Declarative trigger installation from a single SCHEDULE list; add failure alerting

Finding: All triggers owned by one individual user account
Business impact if unaddressed: Every scheduled job stops silently if that account is suspended or the person leaves
Recommendation: Recreate triggers under a shared service account; document the ownership

Finding: Nine tabs with no inbound references and no edits in 14 months
Business impact if unaddressed: Recalculation cost and cognitive load for no benefit
Recommendation: Confirm with the owner then archive and delete

Finding: CloseDate stored as text on 340 rows
Business impact if unaddressed: Text dates silently drop out of every period filter and understate the period
Recommendation: Coerce on import; add a typed-date health check

Finding: SUMIFS grid of ~1200 formulas each scanning the full deal log
Business impact if unaddressed: O(agents x metrics x rows) - roughly 72M cell reads per recalculation
Recommendation: Single QUERY aggregation or script-side rollup into the mart

Finding: 6.4M of the 10M allocated-cell limit consumed
Business impact if unaddressed: Workbook will hit a hard platform limit within ~18 months at current growth
Recommendation: Archive closed periods to the history workbook; delete unused rows and columns

Finding: INDIRECT used to build tab references from a text cell
Business impact if unaddressed: Breaks at runtime on any tab rename and defeats dependency tracking
Recommendation: Direct references or a single QUERY over the mart

Finding: No enforced uniqueness on DealId
Business impact if unaddressed: Duplicate deals double-count revenue with no visible symptom
Recommendation: Duplicate-key health check as a BLOCKER; add conditional formatting on the input tab

Finding: Departed agents are deleted rather than end-dated
Business impact if unaddressed: Deleting an agent retroactively changes prior closed-period team totals
Recommendation: Add StartDate/EndDate/Active columns; filter by effective date

Finding: No named ranges in a workbook with 184k formulas
Business impact if unaddressed: Restructuring is riskier and slower than it needs to be
Recommendation: Name the handful of ranges referenced across tabs

Finding: 1.1M allocated but unused cells
Business impact if unaddressed: Counts against the workbook cell limit
Recommendation: Delete unused rows and columns

Finding: No indication of when data was last refreshed
Business impact if unaddressed: Users cannot tell whether they are looking at stale figures
Recommendation: Display the script-written LastRefreshed timestamp

Finding: Amount column mixes currency-formatted text and numbers
Business impact if unaddressed: Text amounts are skipped by SUMIFS and understate totals
Recommendation: Coerce on import; add a numeric-type health check

Finding: Input ranges are unprotected
Business impact if unaddressed: An accidental edit to a config value silently changes every downstream report
Recommendation: Protected ranges with named editors; keep the owner unrestricted

Finding: Revenue formatted five different ways across tabs
Business impact if unaddressed: Figures look inconsistent to leadership and invite unnecessary questions
Recommendation: Apply one number format from a single formatting pass

Finding: 14 chart ranges pointing at live calculation tabs rather than the mart
Business impact if unaddressed: Charts re-render on every upstream recalculation
Recommendation: Repoint charts at the mart

Finding: No unit tests for ranking or period logic
Business impact if unaddressed: Any future edit is unverifiable without manual spot-checking
Recommendation: Add Tests.gs covering tie handling and ISO week arithmetic

Finding: No logging; failures are only visible in the Apps Script executions view
Business impact if unaddressed: Failures go unnoticed for weeks
Recommendation: Structured log tab plus email alerting on ERROR

Finding: No architecture or operational documentation
Business impact if unaddressed: Knowledge exists in one person's head; onboarding or absence is a business risk
Recommendation: Architecture doc plus runbook delivered at handover

Finding: Trigger: weeklyRollup (time-based Monday 06:00)
Business impact if unaddressed: Confirm still required and owner is current
Recommendation: Declare in SCHEDULE or remove

Finding: Trigger: sendDigest (time-based daily 07:00)
Business impact if unaddressed: Duplicate of weeklyRollup's email step
Recommendation: Consolidate

Finding: Q3 2024 manual adjustment of -18400 hardcoded in a formula
Business impact if unaddressed: Unclear whether still applicable
Recommendation: Confirm with Finance; move to an Adjustments tab if still needed

Finding: Two metrics named "Net Revenue" with different definitions
Business impact if unaddressed: Ambiguity in leadership reporting
Recommendation: Confirm intended definitions with the owner and rename

Finding: Region South feed has not updated since 2026-01-19
Business impact if unaddressed: Possibly a broken import or an intentionally retired region
Recommendation: Confirm with the owner
